cases.name: bound_to_this_activation
cases.why: statement for the new commitment and receipt for this appliance, device key and commitment, both fresh (4.1)

cases.name: licence_expired_but_held_under_the_new_commitment
cases.why: an activation is answered 200 also for an expired licence (9.3); the statement still names the new commitment

cases.name: receipt_missing
cases.why: no activation_receipt: a statement alone is bound to no appliance (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: statement_missing
cases.why: no license member: the rebinding needs the statement for the new commitment (4.1 item 1)

cases.name: statement_names_the_replaced_commitment
cases.why: the statement names the replaced commitment, not that of the configured key (9.4 item 4)

cases.name: receipt_names_the_replaced_commitment
cases.why: the vendor still holds this registration under the replaced commitment (9.8, 9.4 item 4)

cases.name: sister_appliance_answer_spliced_in
cases.why: the receipt names another appliance and device key (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_other_device_key
cases.why: device_pubkey is not the appliance's own (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_fifteen_minutes_old
cases.why: at most 15 minutes off is admissible, in either direction (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_fifteen_minutes_and_a_millisecond_old
cases.why: the receipt's server_ts is more than 15 minutes off (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_fifteen_minutes_ahead
cases.why: exactly 15 minutes ahead is admissible: a fast appliance clock must not block the rebinding (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_fifteen_minutes_and_a_millisecond_ahead
cases.why: the receipt's server_ts is more than 15 minutes off (4.1 item 2)

cases.name: statement_fifteen_minutes_and_a_millisecond_old
cases.why: the statement's server_ts is more than 15 minutes off (4.1 item 1)

cases.name: statement_fifteen_minutes_and_a_millisecond_ahead
cases.why: the statement's server_ts is more than 15 minutes ahead (9.4 item 6, 4.1 item 1)

cases.name: licence_statement_in_the_receipt_member
cases.why: kind is not ledger.activation_receipt.v1 (9.8, 9.4 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_in_the_licence_member
cases.why: kind is not ledger.license_statement.v1 (9.4 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_tampered_after_signing
cases.why: server_signature does not hold over statement_jcs (9.4 item 3)

cases.name: receipt_unknown_key
cases.why: server_key_id names no key valid for the appliance (9.4 item 3)

cases.name: receipt_extra_member
cases.why: members are not exactly those of 9.8 (9.4 item 2)

cases.name: receipt_instant_without_milliseconds
cases.why: server_ts does not have the form of 9.4 item 2

cases.name: reading_copy_names_this_appliance
cases.why: the signed bytes name another appliance; the reading copy is ignored (9.4, 4.1 item 2)

comment: The appliance replaced its licence key and sent the rebinding activation (same appliance_id and device key, proof under the new key). Each case is the 200 answer it received. It MUST count the rebinding as accepted only if expect is rebinding_accepted; rebinding_failed means it repeats with the spacing of section 4 and reports the failure. now is the appliance's clock when the answer arrives.

vendor_test_key.note: test only - never configured on a real server
